title: Caprese Baked Risotto
description: An oven-baked risotto with tomatoes, oregano and basil, topped with mozzarella and Parmesan-style cheese for a Caprese-inspired finish.
ingredients: large handful of basil leaves, to serve
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan (400°F), Gas Mark 6.
Spray an ovenproof dish with low-calorie cooking spray. Stir in the onion, garlic, rice, hot stock, chopped tomatoes, oregano and basil. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake in the oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil, stir thoroughly, then scatter the cherry tomatoes over the top, followed by the mozzarella and Parmesan-style cheese.
Return to the oven (without the foil) for 10 minutes, until the cheese is bubbling and golden. Serve scattered with fresh basil leaves.
notes: To make this non-vegetarian, stir in cooked chicken or bacon with the cherry tomatoes in step 4.
